# PaperDrill

> PaperDrill is a live paper-trading exchange simulator with a real matching engine, live order book, and REST/WebSocket API — built for developers who want to trade or test bots without real money or KYC.

PaperDrill runs BTC/USD, ETH/USD, and SOL/USD spot markets with price-time priority matching, persistent simulated balances, and real-time market data. It is free, browser-based, and designed as a sandbox for learning exchange mechanics and building trading strategies.

## Platform

- [Home](https://paperdrill.dev/): Landing page with product overview and live demo UI
- [Markets](https://paperdrill.dev/markets): Browse live spot markets and 24h stats
- [Trading Console](https://paperdrill.dev/trade/BTC_USD): Full trading UI with order book, chart, and order entry
- [Sign Up](https://paperdrill.dev/signup): Create a free account with simulated starting balances

## Developers

- [Documentation](https://paperdrill.dev/docs): How PaperDrill works — markets, trading, API overview
- [Changelog](https://paperdrill.dev/changelog): Product updates and release notes
- [API](https://api.paperdrill.dev): REST API and WebSocket endpoints (see docs for usage)
